changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM checklist_task_bases WHERE checklist_id IS NULL OR task_bases_id IS NULL;

UPDATE checklist_task_bases relation SET operation_order = ordered.operation_index FROM ( SELECT relation.checklist_id, relation.task_bases_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY relation.checklist_id ORDER BY task_base.created_at ASC, task_base.id ASC ) - 1 AS operation_index FROM checklist_task_bases relation JOIN task_base ON task_base.id = relation.task_bases_id ) ordered WHERE relation.checklist_id = ordered.checklist_id AND relation.task_bases_id = ordered.task_bases_id;
